items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I remember Ake Martin's band and his brother Sam. I played with Sam before I played with Ake.

ctx.x: Or before I went to Mexico or after. I think. Or before I went to Mexico. Ask him who was in the band then. You say who was in the band then.
So did you work with Ake Martin before you went to Mexico or after?
